upstream.description: Learn how to automate faceless short-form + long-form video content and dominate YouTube, TikTok, Facebook & Instagram on autopilot — from idea → script → video → scheduled posts.

classification.analysis: A marketing-driven course and guide repository (all Markdown, no code) teaching people how to produce and monetize AI-generated 'faceless' short/long-form video content across YouTube, TikTok, Instagram and Facebook. It is structured as an 11-module course plus feature/monetization/workflow guides, but functions primarily as a funnel promoting the commercial SaaS product ViralWave Studio. Useful only as reading material for content-creation strategy, not as software.

use_cases.title: Learn a workflow for automating faceless video content
Research monetization strategies for short-form video channels
Evaluate ViralWave Studio as a content-automation tool
